    Industrial Hammer Mill Grinder for Powder Production

    A high-speed hammer mill that pulverizes materials into uniform fine powder by the impact of rotating hammer blades against a sieving screen.

    Product Description

    PURSYS Industrial Hammer Mill Grinder is a high-performance grinding machine designed for crushing and pulverizing various dry materials into fine powder.

    With efficient hammer impact technology and reliable industrial structure, the machine provides stable powder production for food, agricultural, chemical and industrial applications.

    The hammer mill grinder can be integrated into complete powder processing systems including crushing, screening, conveying and packaging equipment.

    An industrial hammer mill grinder is a size reduction machine that uses high-speed rotating hammers to impact and crush materials into smaller particles.

    PURSYS hammer mills are designed for continuous operation, high grinding efficiency and consistent powder quality.

    The equipment is suitable for manufacturers requiring reliable powder processing solutions with flexible production capacity.

    The repeated impact force breaks the material into smaller particles. The final powder size can be controlled through different screen configurations.

    Machine Structure and Details

    PURSYS hammer mill grinders feature a durable grinding chamber, high-strength rotating components and an easy-maintenance structure.

    The machine design focuses on stable operation, efficient material processing and long service life.

    Working Principle of the Industrial Hammer Mill

    An industrial hammer mill reduces dry bulk material into powder through high-speed impact. A rotor fitted with swinging or fixed hammers rotates inside a grinding chamber at several thousand rpm, striking the feed against a perforated screen.

    Particle size is set by the screen hole diameter and rotor speed, so the same machine can make coarse granules or fine powder by swapping screens. The open design allows continuous feeding and easy cleaning between batches.

    How Does a Industrial Hammer Mill Work?

    • Material is fed into the grinding chamber through the inlet hopper.
    • High-speed rotating hammers deliver repeated impact that shatters the particles.
    • Powder passes the screen only when it is smaller than the screen openings.
    • Oversized particles stay in the chamber and are struck again until they pass.
    • Finished powder discharges from the bottom outlet for collection or conveying.

    Material Compatibility of the Industrial Hammer Mill

    The Industrial Hammer Mill is suitable for the following materials:

    Spices and Condiments
    Chili, pepper, turmeric, ginger and mixed seasonings.

    Grains and Food
    Rice, corn, wheat, sugar and food ingredients.

    Herbs and Botanicals
    Dried leaves, roots and traditional medicinal materials.

    Chemicals and Minerals
    Pigments, additives and brittle industrial powders.

    Note: Best for dry, brittle materials. Wet, oily or fibrous materials tend to clog the screen and should be pre-treated or processed on a different mill.

    How to Choose a Industrial Hammer Mill for Powder Processing?

    Consider these factors before purchasing:

    • Required capacity — Match the model to your hourly output, from 20 to 1200 kg/h across the HM series.
    • Material hardness and moisture — Hard or high-moisture feed needs a stronger rotor and wider screen openings.
    • Target fineness — Choose screen mesh and rotor speed for the desired mesh size, typically 10 to 120 mesh.
    • Contact material — Select SUS304 or SUS316L for food and pharmaceutical grade.
    • Dust control — Add a pulse dust collector for fine or hazardous powders.
    • Customization and support — Confirm layout, voltage and spare-hammer supply with the manufacturer.
